env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/plat$GOEXE ./l/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/plat$GOEXE
stdout '^find-ok: true gadget$'
stdout '^lookup-nil$'
stdout '^lookup-store: gadget$'
stdout '^generic: gadget false$'
stdout '^panic-store: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*item\.Item at main\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^panic-call: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*item\.Item at main\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^field-store: gadget$'
stdout '^method-store: gadget$'
stdout '^panic-field: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*item\.Item at main\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^panic-method: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*item\.Item at main\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
stdout '^stdlib-parse: true example\.com$'
stdout '^stdlib-nil$'
stdout '^stdlib-store: example\.com$'
stdout '^panic-stdlib: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*url\.URL at main\.lgo:[0-9]+$'
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/item/item.go --
package item

import "errors"

type Item struct {
	Name string
}

var errMissing = errors.New("no such item")

func Find(name string) (*Item, error) {
	if name == "x" {
		return &Item{Name: "gadget"}, nil
	}
	return nil, errMissing
}

func Lookup(name string) *Item {
	if name == "x" {
		return &Item{Name: "gadget"}
	}
	return nil
}

type Box struct {
	Inner *Item
}

func NewBox(name string) *Box {
	return &Box{Inner: Lookup(name)}
}

func (b *Box) Get() *Item {
	return b.Inner
}

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/url"

	"example.com/g/item"
)

func First[T any](s []T) T {
	return s[0]
}

func useItem(it *item.Item) string {
	return it.Name
}

func tryStore() (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	var it *item.Item = item.Lookup("missing")
	return "no-panic:" + it.Name
}

func tryCall() (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	return useItem(item.Lookup("missing"))
}

func tryField() (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	empty := item.NewBox("missing")
	var it *item.Item = empty.Inner
	return "no-panic:" + it.Name
}

func tryMethod() (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	empty := item.NewBox("missing")
	return useItem(empty.Get())
}
func tryStdlibStore() (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	bad, berr := url.Parse("://bad-url")
	if berr == nil {
		return "unexpected-no-error"
	}
	var keep *url.URL = bad
	return "no-panic:" + keep.Host
}

func main() {
	it, err := item.Find("x")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("find-err:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("find-ok:", it != nil, it.Name)

	if item.Lookup("missing") == nil {
		fmt.Println("lookup-nil")
	}

	here := item.Lookup("x")
	var keep *item.Item = here
	fmt.Println("lookup-store:", keep.Name)

	got := First([]*item.Item{here})
	fmt.Println("generic:", got.Name, got == nil)

	full := item.NewBox("x")
	var kept *item.Item = full.Inner
	fmt.Println("field-store:", kept.Name)
	fmt.Println("method-store:", useItem(full.Get()))

	fmt.Println("panic-store:", tryStore())
	fmt.Println("panic-call:", tryCall())
	fmt.Println("panic-field:", tryField())
	fmt.Println("panic-method:", tryMethod())
	parsed, perr := url.Parse("https://example.com/gadget")
	if perr != nil {
		fmt.Println("stdlib-err:", perr)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("stdlib-parse:", parsed != nil, parsed.Host)
	badProbe, badErr := url.Parse("://bad-url")
	if badErr == nil {
		fmt.Println("unexpected-no-error")
	}
	if badProbe == nil {
		fmt.Println("stdlib-nil")
	}
	var keepStd *url.URL = parsed
	fmt.Println("stdlib-store:", keepStd.Host)
	fmt.Println("panic-stdlib:", tryStdlibStore())
}
